_comment: Policy: fail the build on MEDIUM or HIGH severity findings in our own code.
Informational, low and optimization findings are still reported in the job
log but do not block a merge.
filter_paths excludes dependencies. OpenZeppelin v5 is widely audited and we
do not vendor-patch it, so its findings are noise we could not act on without
forking the library. Only contracts/ is treated as in scope.
Two detectors are excluded, each justified below. Nothing that could mask a
real vulnerability in TaxToken.sol is excluded:
naming-convention - constructor parameters use the trailing-underscore
style (name_, symbol_) to disambiguate from the ERC20 getters they feed.
This is the OpenZeppelin house style and a deliberate readability choice.
solc-version - the compiler is pinned to an exact 0.8.24 rather than a
floating caret range. Slither flags non-latest pins; an exact pin is the
stronger supply-chain position, so the flag runs contrary to our intent.
